overall: Tomorrow (Wednesday, July 8) is expected to be a mostly cloudy, humid day with lingering fog and a chance of morning rain showers tapering off by mid-morning, driven by a persistent tropical air mass that is keeping moisture levels elevated across the DC area. Afternoon conditions may see some partial clearing, but cloud cover and residual moisture will likely cap daytime heating.
